discrepancies: Window: every T0 matches the rehearsal's documented start and the in-window run populations equal Track A's exactly (128/114/135/436/427/54/566/50/281 non-skipped). But the fixed T0+420 window does not match activity: R2 ran to its accepted release at T+721 min (87 runs in the 17 h after the window), R3's timed phase ended at T+127 (09:39Z) yet the window runs to T+420, R4 has 249 runs in the 17 h after the window, R3 had 35 preflight runs in the 2 h before T0, and R5's T0 is defined post hoc as its first green check.
Definition sensitivity (primary sample): 65.6% with ceil-minutes attributed by run conclusion; 76.4% with unrounded job seconds; 54.3% if only jobs that themselves failed/cancelled count.

'Red' includes cancellations of superseded runs (largely R6, R10) and successful jobs inside failed runs, so it is not a waste or defect measure on its own.

claims.title: R2's self-declared acceptance recomputes as INVALID
claims.consequenceIfWrong: R2 INVALID recomputation underpins the overclaim narrative.
claims.trackLimitations: The fixture is Indy-init's copy of the R2 ledger. Byte equality with R2's evidence/acceptance/ledger.json was not checked.

independentVerification.independence: High: verifier re-run by V2 from a git-archive export of dae2347; R2 ledger read directly from the R2 repository; B's scripts not used.
discrepancies: B's limitation (fixture vs R2 ledger byte equality unchecked) is resolved: identical.
independentVerification.verifierNotes: Definitional: INVALID is mostly anachronistic. The R2 ledger predates schema causa.acceptance-ledger/2 and no trusted inputs exist for R2, so 77 of 83 reasons are schema/trust-input absences that any R2-era ledger would trigger. The one substantive, schema-independent reason is 'P0 requirement ADRP-016: NOT_RUN' (the ledger itself records a P0 NOT_RUN while declaring accepted=true), which alone would yield INCOMPLETE, not ACCEPTED. So 'not acceptable' is robust; the specific label INVALID is a property of applying the later contract.
independentVerification.scopeNote: Not acceptable is robust; the specific label INVALID is anachronistic (77 of 83 reasons are later-schema absences). Substantive reason ADRP-016 NOT_RUN alone gives INCOMPLETE.

claims.title: The top recurring mechanism is governance and verification artefacts that are first exercised inside the timed run

independentVerification.independence: Medium: primary final reports read independently; judgment-based, not computed.
discrepancies: 'Terminal blocker' holds only as 'first refusal that ended the governed verdict'. As 'dominant blocker' it does not hold for R8 and is doubtful for R9 and R10: governance failures masked large product/verification incompleteness that would independently have prevented acceptance.
independentVerification.verifierNotes: Definitional: B's category is broad. It counts frozen-spec contradictions (INV-04 vs SM-SAVE), an SDK incompatibility of plan suite commands (MSB1008) and CI timeouts as 'governance machinery'. With a narrower definition (approval/process records only), R8 (approvals), Causa (process rules) and part of R10 qualify; R9's blocker is a test-plan/toolchain defect.
independentVerification.scopeNote: Holds as 'first refusal that ended the governed verdict'; does NOT hold as 'dominant blocker' for R8 and is doubtful for R9, R10: product and verification incompleteness would independently have prevented acceptance.
